name: Helm
verdict: HELM AG, a Hamburg family-owned chemical trading company. Nothing found.
note: Family-owned private Aktiengesellschaft; no state body or fund found anywhere in the chain (parent: null). The company's own Historie page traces it to Hermann Schnabel's 1950 purchase and his family since. Sleeve partner of HSV since 2024/25 for three seasons, donating the league-match sleeve presence to Plan International Deutschland; no human-rights finding found.
